documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Hero MotoCorp reported its highest-ever annual topline and bottom line for FY26 while maintaining its industry leadership for 25 consecutive years. Management highlighted strong growth momentum across scooters, EVs, global business, and premium categories like Harley-Davidson. The company announced plans to commit over ₹1,500 crores in capex for FY27 to expand capacity in scooters and EVs. Despite facing near-term commodity and wage headwinds, the company remains committed to its medium-term EBITDA margin guidance of 14% to 16%. Hero MotoCorp reported a strong financial and operational performance for FY 2025-26, achieving record annual revenue of ₹ 46,830 crore and a PAT of ₹ 5,268 crore.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates high single-digit volume growth for the two-wheeler industry during the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: We are confident in the growth prospects of the 2-wheeler industry and anticipate high single-digit growth during the current fiscal year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to grow ahead of the industry supported by resilient demand and upcoming product launches.
guidance.quote: With resilient demand and upcoming product launches, we expect to grow ahead of the industry.

guidance.claim: Management expects the company to grow ahead of the industry supported by new product launches and investments.
guidance.quote: The current demand trend is broad-based across our portfolio and with new product launches supported by investment behind brand building, we expect to grow ahead of the industry.

guidance.claim: The industry for the next financial year is projected to grow in high single digits due to a high base in the second half.
guidance.quote: So overall, the industry for the next financial year is likely to grow in high single digits.

demand_outlook.claim: The two-wheeler sector started the year on a positive note, continuing the momentum from the second half of FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: On the demand side, 2-wheeler sector has started the year on a positive note, continuing the momentum that we saw in the second half of FY '26.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects scooters to grow a couple of points more than motorcycles.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, we do expect scooters to grow a couple of points more than motorcycles.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the industry experienced strong growth momentum with total domestic dispatches growing by 10.7% YoY.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian two-wheeler industry continues to demonstrate strong growth momentum, with FY 2025-26 marking the fourth consecutive year of expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: Post-festive demand continues to stay strong with January 2026 retail growing at 21% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Post festive demand continues to stay strong with January '26 retail growing at 21% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the later part of quarter 4 to be very strong from a rural perspective due to the wedding season and early festives.
demand_outlook.quote: We also expect that as we see the wedding season unfolding from February onwards, some early festives that set in from March, we expect quarter 4 also to be strong -- the later part of quarter 4 also to be very strong from a rural perspective.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand trends are observed to be broad-based across the portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The current demand trend is broad-based across our portfolio and with new product launches supported by investment behind brand building, we expect to grow ahead of the industry.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has committed over ₹1,500 crores of capex in FY27 to expand capacity in growth segments like scooters and electric vehicles.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing in capacity expansion, and we have committed over ₹1,500 crores of capex in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Hero MotoCorp committed over ₹700 crores of investment to build a global parts center in South India.
capex_expansion.quote: So we've committed over ₹700 crores of investment in building out a global parts center in South of India.

margins_costs.claim: The ICE business EBITDA margin in Q4 FY26 expanded by 100 basis points year-on-year to 17%.
margins_costs.quote: ICE business EBITDA margin in the quarter expanded by 100 basis points year-on-year to 17%, driven by pricing, LEAP savings and operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: ICE business EBITDA margin expanded by 100 bps year-on-year to 17%, driven by pricing, LEAP savings, and operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: ICE business EBITDA margin expanded by 100 bps year-on-year to 17%, driven by pricing, LEAP savings and operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: Overall EBITDA margins improved by 20 basis points to 14.7% after taking into account investments behind the EV business.
margins_costs.quote: During the quarter, after taking into account the investments behind EV business, approximately INR208 crores, the overall EBITDA margins improved 20 basis points to 14.7%.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity impact in the previous quarter was approximately 40 to 50 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: So your first part of the question was how much is the impact coming from the commodity in the previous quarter was approximately 40 to 50 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The company took a price increase of INR300 per vehicle starting from the 1st of January.
margins_costs.quote: The price hike we've taken in January was INR300 is what we've taken from 1st of January per vehicle, INR300 per vehicle.

orders_capacity.claim: Dealer inventory is currently at around 5 weeks.
orders_capacity.quote: So in terms of the dealer inventory, it's around 5 weeks, I'll say.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a final dividend of ₹75 per share, taking total FY26 dividend to ₹185 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: I'm happy to inform that the Board has declared final dividend of ₹75 per share, taking the total dividend in financial year '26 to ₹185, our highest ever dividend.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operations for FY26 stood at ₹9,395 crores, representing an 80% increase year-on-year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our focus on cash management resulted in strong cash flow from operations, which stood at ₹9,395 crores for the full year '26, an increase of 80% year-on-year, driven by working capital improvements.

capital_allocation.claim: CSR spend for the standalone company was ₹ 97.3 crore during the year.
Operating cash generated in the first 9 months stands at INR7,045 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Operating cash generated in 9 months stands at INR7,045 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The broader economy is navigating short-term uncertainties due to developments in West Asia.
risks_headwinds.quote: As FY '27 begins, the broader economy is navigating certain short-term uncertainties due to the developments in West Asia.

risks_headwinds.claim: Developments in West Asia have impacted the industry regarding commodity costs for metals, gas, and labor costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: That has impacted the entire industry in terms of commodity costs, be it cost of metals, cost of gas or in the recent past, also we've seen an increase in certain labor costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The year 2026 began with heightened uncertainty shaped by persistent geopolitical tensions, volatility in commodity prices, and shifting trade policies.
risks_headwinds.quote: Against this background, the Indian economy stands out as a bright spot and fastest, largest growing economy for '26.

risks_headwinds.claim: During the quarter, the company took cognizance of the new labour code and made a provision of INR119 crores reported as an exceptional item.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the quarter, the company has taken cognizance of the new labour code and has made provision of INR119 crores, which is reported as an exceptional item.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to its medium-term EBITDA margin guidance of 14% to 16%.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to our medium-term margin guidance of 14% to 16%.

management_commitments.claim: The management stated they will focus on executing and accelerating growth ambitions over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: As I look forward to the next few years of our journey, we will focus on executing and accelerating our growth ambitions.

management_commitments.claim: Hero Finance plans to increase secured lending to mid-70s next year.
management_commitments.quote: They've already moved it from 61% to 68% and the plan is to really take it to mid-70s next year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects capacity expansion for EVs to show a marked increase in fiscal year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we are looking at F '27 as the year in which we would be able to see a marked increase on this front.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
